## [0.2.1] - 2026-06-11

### Added
- Atomic single-use check-in: one QR/token cannot admit twice (CAS, ADR 0001)
- Recent check-in history endpoint
- Temporary operator Bearer gate on `/api/checkin/*`

---

### Deploy
- Run `npm run build` and `npm run db:migrate` on deploy.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/blob/v0.2.1/CHANGELOG.md)
